listing.name: Diamond Legacy (EN Translation)
listing.summary: A CN translation and adjustment of Diamond Chip's: Diamond Legacy. This version is a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack. It was originally a bounty pack, was unable to effectively translate the Magiclib Bounty Data so it exists in this form as a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large number of superships to pirates, Luddic Path, Persean League, and Hegemony factions, along with zero-DP dmods offering risky benefits.

description: This is a translation and adjustment of the Diamond Legacy mod, converted from a bounty pack into a ship, weapons, and hullmod pack. It introduces many superships to pirate factions and adds lore-friendly ships to the Luddic Path, Persean League, and Hegemony. The pack includes dmods that can be installed for 0 DP on the refit screen, providing questionable benefits with significant downsides.
